spec.description: Registration status of the native VPLMN UE (via the SMF), confirming the scenario runs entirely locally with no HPLMN dependency.
spec.title: UE Attach Status

spec.description: Total number of F1 handover triggers issued during the mobility simulation (DU0 ↔ DU1).
spec.title: Handover Counter

spec.description: Cell currently serving the UE according to the last handover trigger issued by the mobility controller.
spec.title: Serving Cell (post-handover, source de vérité)

spec.description: Timeline of which DU has served the UE over time, showing each handover transition.
spec.title: Handover Timeline

spec.description: Relative position of the UE along a simulated line between DU0 (gNB1) and DU1 (gNB2), derived from the path loss ratio. This is not a real geographic position — a simulated linear proxy for distance.
spec.title: UE Position (relative to DU0/DU1)

spec.description: Actual RSRP reported by OAI's PHY layer, parsed directly from DU log output. Unlike the "Estimated RSRP" panel (a formula derived from the telnet-controlled path loss), this value is an independent measurement of the same physical link.
spec.title: Real RSRP (measured by PHY layer)

spec.description: Actual uplink SNR reported by OAI's PHY layer, parsed directly from DU log output. Unlike RSRP (which saturates due to automatic receive gain compensation in this RFsimulator setup, see report), SNR reflects the real signal degradation because the gain amplifies both signal and noise equally.
spec.title: Real SNR (uplink, measured by PHY layer)

spec.description: Estimated received signal power (RSRP), derived from the simulated path loss (RSRP ≈ -60 - path loss). Indicative value, not an actual radio measurement.
spec.title: Estimated RSRP

spec.description: Estimated Channel Quality Indicator (CQI), approximated from the estimated SINR (CQI ≈ SINR / 2, floored at 0).
spec.title: Estimated SINR

spec.description: Estimated Channel Quality Indicator (CQI), approximated from the estimated SINR (CQI ≈ SINR / 2, floored at 0).
spec.title: Estimated CQI

spec.description: Estimated user throughput as a function of the simulated radio quality (throughput decreases as path loss increases).
spec.title: Estimated Throughput

spec.description: Estimated packet loss rate as a function of the simulated path loss.
spec.title: Packet Loss

spec.description: Cell currently most favorable for the UE, determined by the lowest path loss between the two DUs.
spec.title: Serving Cell

spec.description: Current direction of the UE's simulated movement between the two cells.
spec.title: Mobility Direction

spec.description: relative position of the UE between the two cells, represented by the path loss toward DU0 (gNB1).
spec.title: Relative Distance ( toward DU0 )
